rationale: Ahmad is building AI-native hardware at Midjourney with deep expertise in spatial computing and hand-tracking from Vision Pro and Leap Motion, while Anthony leads spatial intelligence R&D at SpatialVerse focused on 3D reconstruction and scene understanding—their work in computer vision and spatial domains are directly complementary. Ahmad's conviction that next-gen AI hardware must be deeply integrated with generative AI models, combined with Anthony's cutting-edge work in AI-powered 3D modeling and layout generation, could unlock new possibilities for spatial AI interfaces.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Anthony Zhao — you're both pushing spatial computing forward from different angles (hardware integration vs. 3D scene intelligence) and should compare notes on where AI-native spatial interfaces are headed.
